title: Hearing It Again And Again, I Am
summary: Attachment is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights
source.lifeApplication: Attachment becomes more truthful when hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

evidence.coreClaim: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights
evidence.turn: Attachment steadies when as Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind.
evidence.practicalImplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
